rationale: Both Shawn and Charvi work in robotics—Shawn as co-founder of Addition Robotics focused on robotic manipulation, and Charvi as a platform software engineer at Chef Robotics building robotics systems and infrastructure. Charvi's experience with robotics systems and Python expertise could offer useful perspective on the infrastructure and software challenges in manipulation robotics that Addition Robotics is tackling.
intro_message: Shawn, meet Charvi Aggarwal—a platform software engineer at Chef Robotics who builds robotics systems infrastructure and might have useful insights for your manipulation robotics work.
